text:
incident-bot: URGENT: spike detected for service.gateway.euwest - 5xx rate 8.2% (baseline 0.2%) starting 03:12 UTC. TLS alerts and handshake failures increasing. Paging primary oncall (jen). graph: https://dash.internal/redwood/alerts?srv=gateway&e=5xx

jen: ack — joining. I'm already seeing repeated `tls: handshake failure` and `tls: unexpected message` in ingress logs. tagging SRE + infra. @raj can you pull proxy logs and cert inventory?

raj: running quick checks. `kubectl get secrets -n ingress` shows ingress-ca bundle present, last-updated 2026-03-14T01:05:00Z. running `openssl s_client -connect proxy01.euwest:443 -showcerts -servername proxy01.euwest` returns:
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
139912...error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert handshake failure
---
no peer certificate available
---
\nVerify return code: 10 (certificate has expired)
```

raj: logs show a subset of connections failing with `verify error:num=10:certificate has expired` when verifying the intermediate chain. hypothesis: rotator failed to publish rotated intermediate to a subset of the proxy pool.

jen: impact assessment — enterprise customers using mTLS (webhooks and partner integrations) seeing 5xx and timeouts. marking incident P1. Elaine, can CS triage customer-facing comms?

elaine: already on it — CS seeing ~9 customer reports, 3 classified as high impact (webhooks failing). holding template for outgoing notice until we have an ETA.

mike: started emergency traffic steering to eu-central and us-west where cert chains validated. fallback reduced global errors to ~3.4% but eu-west still impacted. We can keep steering but we need a hotfix in eu-west proxies.

raj: attempted to trigger rotator publish to ingress namespace: `curl -s -X POST https://rotator.internal/api/v1/publish -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"ns":"ingress","secret":"ingress-ca"}'`
rotator responded: `HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error` and logs show repeated `write failed: no space left on device` and `rotate: persist failed: disk quota exceeded`.

jen: that explains missing intermediate on some nodes. plan of action: 1) manual promote backup CA bundle to affected proxies (manual scp + proxy reload) 2) free rotator ephemeral storage and resume publish 3) redeploy rotator with corrected retention and disk alerts. executing step 1 now.

raj: pushing backup bundle to proxies and reloading. commands I'm running:
```
scp /opt/certs/backup-ingress-ca.pem admin@proxy01.euwest:/etc/proxy/backup-ca.pem
ssh admin@proxy01.euwest 'proxyctl config set --ca /etc/proxy/backup-ca.pem && proxyctl reload'
```

rotator-bot: rotator: cleanup job started by raj. freed 5.8GB, disk usage now 22%.

mike: reloads finishing — 5 of 7 proxies reloaded cleanly and are serving the backup CA. traffic errors dropped to ~1.0%. two proxies stuck in reload loop with `error: failed to write cert to disk: read-only file system` — investigating remnant mount issue from yesterday's deploy.

raj: mounting check shows /var/lib/rotator was remounted ro on two nodes due to systemd-fsck fallback after noisy logrotate. planning a quick remount rw + restart proxyctl on those nodes.

mike: remount + restart done on proxy06, proxies are healthy. proxy07 still failing with kernel-level I/O errors; taking it out of LB. current 5xx ~0.6%.

elaine: sending CS update: "We have routed traffic around an expired certificate and are performing an orchestrated fix. Most customers restored; a small subset may still see transient errors. We'll follow up with full post-incident details."

jen: handing primary to mike for the next 45 minutes to watch mitigation and finish rotator redeploy. mike please confirm takeover.

mike: taking primary. I'll continue to monitor and coordinate redeploy. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: ACTION: created incident record INC-2026-179; oncall handoff logged.

jen: thanks all — initial mitigation complete. I'll own postmortem once rotator is healthy and we have full timelines. pls keep notes here for RCA. :thumbsup:
